AgentCompass v0.7.4 makes every answer that is not what you asked for say what decided it and what to do next, and counts an account's dispatch cadence from the dispatches that really launched.

- **A refusal names its reason.** `roll`, `plan`, `record`, `dispatch`, the Paseo bridge and the gate were audited for answers that refuse, defer or do nothing without saying why. Each now names the deciding fact (the candidate, the quota window and the hours; the worker's state; the bridge's condition; the check the gate could not make) and a way out that works for the caller. A flag a stage does not read is said instead of dropped, and a plan says when your own local settings kept the closest candidates out.
- **`select` and `delegate` are removed.** `plan` could tell you to run the `select` stage, which nothing could feed. A plan decides a near tie by its documented order and needs no further step. The flags `--judge` and `--timeout` are gone with them; a `judges` entry in your `host-policy.json` is left in the file and read by nothing.
- **Dispatch cadence.** An account's cadence (ChatGPT Web: 5 dispatches in 12 hours) is counted from dispatches that launched, finished ones included; a plan that launched nothing no longer uses a seat. Automatic routing is held to the cadence. A route you name launches past it with one warning that gives the count, the limit and when a seat frees. A project rule (`record --constraint hard_constraint` or `dot_closed_loop`) is refused at the limit.
- **`--resume`.** A worker you name is resumed whatever the age of its last dispatch; a refused resume names the fact. `roll --resume <id> --dry-run` answers that the two do not combine instead of failing.
- **Working-directory rules.** An account's `cwd_regex` is matched against the directory the worker will run in (`--workspace`, or the resumed worker's own directory), not the caller's. An explicit `--resume` of a worker whose directory is unknown, on an account with such a rule, is refused.
- **Pi.** Pi's ChatGPT usage window is named by its length, as Codex's is, so the launch check now reads it.
- **Antigravity.** The three Orchestrator options have scores, read between their planner and Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
- **Maintainer scores.** Nine hand-written scores were set to the level the public boards measure (GPT-6 Sol, Luna and Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Fable 5.2: coding faithfulness, execution, responsiveness, image recognition, creativity). Installs of v0.7.1 and later already read them through the published data; the data schema stays 8.
- **Fixed.** Two processes that opened a settings store for the first time at the same moment could fail with "Permission denied" on Windows. A collection error after a worker finished no longer leaves its dispatch open.

Exit codes that moved: `record --basis` over 400 characters and `record --trigger workflow` without `user_override` exit 1; `record` with a project rule on an account outside `allowed_accounts` answers `blocked`, exit 2; `--account` alone is refused as `--provider` alone is; `roll` with route flags refuses a `--constraint` other than `user_override`; a Dot runner that exits 3 with no task id is an error, exit 1.

After updating: if `agentcompass providers` lists an exhausted window named `primary` or `secondary` for Pi, it was stored under the old window names and stops no launch. Clear it with `agentcompass -X utf8 "%LOCALAPPDATA%/AgentCompass/app/current/skills/agent-compass/scripts/quota_exhaustion.py" --clear pi` on the Windows install (`python -X utf8 <that script> --clear pi` on a Python install).

Not verified: `dispatch --dispatch-action prepare` and `launch`, `usage` with an unreadable `--usage-cache`, Herdr's real output and the bridge against a live Paseo daemon were not part of the audit's runs. Two rolls that plan at the same moment with one cadence seat left can both take it. The boards were not read again for this release: scores are those of the 2026-11-18 snapshot plus what was published since. The local Windows Sandbox installer check was not run for this release.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.7.4/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
